result.primary: You'll need an electronic travel authorisation (ETA) or a visa

tourist_prohibitions: do paid or unpaid work for a UK company or as a self-employed person
live in the UK for long periods of time through frequent or successive visits
marry or register a civil partnership, or give notice of marriage or civil partnership
details.required_border_document: a valid passport or travel document valid for the whole stay
possible_border_proofs: able to support yourself and your dependents during the trip or have funding from someone else
able to pay for the return or onward journey or have funding from someone else
will leave the UK at the end of the visit
